title: Discord folders
description: This Plugin Adds Support for For your Plugins Folder to edit via Discord my first Plugin So have fun with it, this is on curseforge aswell!
body:
A plugin that Makes it so you can acces your Plugins From your Discord Server,
what This does is just makes it so every path every, file inside your Minecraft Server you can acces From Discord i made this Mainly for minehut servers but can be used on any PAPER servers, you cant Upload Files For Safety!
